column2: # score each basin from 0 to 1 on each criterion
# preservation: 4 is the freshest so it gets a 1.
# 0 means heavily eroded/not in the Robbins & Hynek database,
# Goudge et al. (2016) count those as a 1, so I'm doing the same
# inlet: VN (older, bigger systems) is better than II (younger, episodic)
# stream order: 5 and up all count as the max (there's only a few higher than 5 and I don't want them to stretch the scale)
# basin type: closed a bit higher than open b/c of better preservation potential
# final score = each criterion score times its AHP weight, added together
# rank them. min_rank gives ties the same rank
# taking a look at top basins
select(basin_id, Lat, Lon, Inlet, Strahler, Degr, score, rank) |>
